fusions.name: Silver Fry
fusions.desc: Flicks a shoal of 3 slim knives in a spread, each dealing 4 damage.

fusions.name: Gill to Tail
fusions.desc: Fillets a target at or below 25% health, dealing 22 damage plus 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which this blow uses up.

fusions.name: Gone Downstream
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds, during which you move 25% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Slips the Grip
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
